column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a branch ending on a merge of main is titled by its own last commit
a branch of nothing but record commits is titled by the newest of them, not the merge
a branch that merged another unlanded branch is titled by its own work, not that branch's
a commit that changes the record and more is the branch's own
a root commit made only of a record is the landing's too
a squash gh gave no title for is subjected by the newest commit the branch made itself
an empty commit is not passed over as the landing's
an engine change under a record's subject is the branch's own
and so is a file elsewhere that shares a record's name
and so is one the landing then gave a version slot, a record and a handoff section
signed commits leave the title the branch's own under log.showSignature
